do_if.value: md.X4LAN_Attachment.State.$active and md.X4LAN_Attachment.State.$epoch == $v.$epoch and md.X4LAN_Seed.State.$id == $v.$seed and md.X4LAN_Seed.State.$loads == 1 and md.X4LAN_Bubble.Arena.$localSlot == 2 and not md.X4LAN_Bubble.Arena.$host and $v.$ship ge 1 and $v.$ship le md.X4LAN_Seed.State.$ships.count

set_value.name: $valid
set_value.exact: $ship.isoperational and $ship.idcode == $v.$code and $ship.macro.id == $v.$macro and $ship.owner.id == $v.$owner and $ship != md.X4LAN_Bubble.Arena.$donor and not md.X4LAN_Bubble.Arena.$ships.indexof.{$ship} and not md.X4LAN_Bubble.Arena.$targets.indexof.{$ship}

do_if.value: player.timewarp.factor gt 0s and not $ship.dock.exists and not $ship.isinternallystored

debug_text.text: '[X4LAN] REPLICA_HOLD_NATIVE applied id=%s code=%s macro=%s owner=%s sector=%s mode=constant_zero'.[$v.$ship,$ship.idcode,$ship.macro.id,$ship.owner.id,$ship.sector.macro.id]
